explanations.3: This tells Docker to skip interactive prompts during package installation, which would otherwise hang the build waiting for user input.
explanations.11: This deletes the package manager's cache after installation to shrink the final image size, since we won't need to reinstall those packages.
explanations.15: The install script wires up fzf shortcuts into bash, and the --no-update-rc flag prevents it from modifying .bashrc (we do that manually on the next line instead).
explanations.22: The printf command uses %s to substitute the loop variable $i, creating filenames like run1.sh.log, run2.sh.log, etc.
explanations.41: This adds a fancy colored prompt with emoji to the bashrc file; the \e codes are ANSI color escapes that paint the text in different colors when you see it on screen.
explanations.43: The -i flag starts bash in interactive mode so you get a real shell prompt instead of just executing one command and exiting.
